answer: Ivory Stake Protocol audits identity via graph staking. 1) An ivory peer stakes 50 tokens to vouch for a new applicant. 2) The applicant joins the nebula subgraph and receives trust weight proportional to the locked stake. 3) An echo auditor verifies interactions, slashing the ivory stake if fraudulent clones appear. Creating N identities costs 50 x N tokens with 2 endorsements minimum per node. The mechanism fails if a cartel controls over 51 percent of total staked tokens, validating clones without financial risk. Trust spreads like clear dye through clean water.
